description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a user profile screen, including UI layout, profile image selection, and navigation to other screens.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the user's profile screen with avatar management and navigation options.

methods.name: pickProfileImage
methods.description: Prompts the user to pick an image from gallery or camera without persisting it and updates the preview.

methods.name: _showPickImageSheet
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet to choose image source or remove existing profile image.

methods.name: _buildAvatarPreview
methods.description: Builds the avatar widget with current selected image or default placeholder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main layout of the profile screen with user info, avatar, banners, and menu items.
